body:
This is already done in `platform_methods.py::get_build_version()` so it could be extracted from `name`.

Though I'm not sure why we even have `platform_methods.py::get_build_version()` that duplicates what `method.py::get_version_info()` provides, maybe they should be unified back so the logic to deal with `version.py` and env variables is in a single place.
